statements: « L'app crash instantanément dès son lancement » (6.1.0 on the owner's phone)

done.investigation: the crash was not reproduced: the whole app (KetvoiceApp, MainActivity, first frames) starts under Robolectric on SDK 34, 35 and 36, in debug and release, with the real PlaybackService bound; every manifest component of the released mobile APK exists in its dex, and every Material icon the Lite APK references is present
done.safe_mode: util/CrashLoop counts launches that did not last 10 s; after two in a row with a crash report newer than the previous launch, SafeModeActivity (plain Android views) shows the report with Share, Copy and Try again
done.crash_reports: Crash.install runs first in KetvoiceApp.onCreate in every process; reports carry version, code and flavour
done.root_cause: unknown at publication; the owner is asked to share the safe-mode report

not_validated: the owner's crash at launch of 6.1.0: not reproduced and not fixed at the root; safe mode is meant to bring its report

known_limitations: No Wear OS app in this version.
Android Auto's queue screen shows only the current song.
Switching between Ketvoice and Ketvoice Lite is a manual install of the other APK.
Ketogether guests hear titles their own sources can play; local files and private titles are shown as unavailable.
Launcher icons keep a background: Android fills adaptive icon backgrounds in black.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
